build_dir: a1 on work/agent-battle-build-10, a2 on work/agent-battle-build-12; Mega Clefable evolved on its first action on both

attempts.notes: Sand + Smooth Rock on entry; Gigalith's Heavy Slam plus sand chip removed Whimsicott T1 after its Sash; both leads Protected T2; Double-Edge + Headlong Rush KO'd Sandslash and Gigalith T3; Whimsicott's Prankster Tailwind let Wise Glasses Rotom-Wash out-speed and OHKO Mega Kangaskhan (Hydro Pump 184) and later Incineroar (394 from full); Necrozma's Photon Geyser OHKO'd Great Tusk and Earth Power forced Raging Bolt into Protects; it ended Kingambit (burned by Rotom's Will-O-Wisp) 79 HP short of a second Iron Head on Mega Clefable, which out-sped it.

Fake Out Gigalith T1; Sandslash Protected the T2 double-target and Gigalith's Heavy Slam crit KO'd Whimsicott (Sash already eaten by sand); Sucker Punch + Headlong Rush removed Sandslash and Gigalith T4; Iron Head KO'd Keira's Whimsicott as it set Tailwind; Thunderbolt KO'd Rotom, then Necrozma's Earth Power took Bolt to 34; Mega Clefable's Follow Me pulled both my attacks and Iron Head (2x) OHKO'd it (370); Necrozma Protected once and died to Flare Blitz. Necrozma was only ever hit neutrally, so the Weakness Policy never fired.

strategy_checks.check: Sand Stream + Smooth Rock live on entry; Sand Rush Sandslash attacks
strategy_checks.evidence: Sand at turn 0 both attempts (lasted 8 turns); Sandslash's chosen T1 move was Rock Slide/High Horsepower each time, out-speeding my Tailwind-less leads.

strategy_checks.check: Clefable Follow Me as a genuine decision (can disarm the Policy)
strategy_checks.evidence: a2 T8 Follow Me pulled Thunderclap and Iron Head off Necrozma onto Mega Clefable, which died to the 2x Iron Head - it protected the Policy holder at the cost of the Mega. a1 T11 it Protected on entry instead.
I never hit it super-effectively; it OHKO'd Great Tusk with Photon Geyser (a1 T8) and took Raging Bolt apart with Earth Power across both attempts. Protect a1 T7 / a2 T7, T9.

strategy_checks.check: Whimsicott Prankster Tailwind / Encore backup speed plan
strategy_checks.evidence: Prankster Tailwind chosen T5 in both attempts the moment Sandslash was gone; it made Rotom out-speed Mega Kangaskhan (a1) and Raging Bolt (a2).
Hydro Pump OHKOs on Kangaskhan/Incineroar (a1), Will-O-Wisp on Kingambit (a1 T7), Protects on T4/T6/T8 (a1) and T6 (a2) each blocking a KO.
Mega Evolved on first action both attempts; a1 it out-sped and KO'd the burned Kingambit; a2 it Dazzling Gleamed into a Protect then Follow Me'd.

ai_defects.description: a1 T11 / a2 T7: Mega Clefable used Protect on its entry turn with nothing aimed at it (empty Protect) instead of Follow Me while Necrozma was the one under fire.

calibration: Lost 5-6 then won 6-3 - a real post-game fight either way. Keep offsets 1/1/1/1/1/2.
cooler: The Follow Me-versus-Policy tension is real and the AI actually chose the redirect once; the sand plus Prankster Tailwind speed layers stack well. Cooler still if Rotom's Hydro Pump were not the team's best OHKO tool (Wise Glasses on a 105 SpA Rotom is doing more work than the Necrozma concept).
legality: No legality problem found in the authored set.
